messages:
Aisha: Starting thread for Meridian POC. They sent security questionnaire asking for SSO + SCIM + RBAC detail and POC pricing. Need: SCIM delta window, SCIM burst/rate limits, SAML attribute mapping example, role provisioning flow, domain verification options, and Hosted vs Dedicated impacts. @Marco @Devina please advise.

Marco: SCIM defaults: delta_window=900s. For Dedicated we can go to 300s. Rate limits default 250 req/min/tenant; POC bump to 500 req/min. Recommend using batch endpoint for initial seed.

Devina: Role provisioning: we map SAML attribute "roles" to internal roles via explicit mapping table. SCIM groups can map to roles too. We never auto-promote to org_admin without mapping. Delegated admin mode is opt-in.

Leo: Domain verification: support DNS TXT and SAML metadata signing. For quick POC, DNS TXT is fastest.

Aisha: Security also asked about auth fallback if IdP unavailable. Need a one-liner for questionnaire.

Devina: One-liner: "Optional email magic-link fallback available when enabled; for Dedicated, subject to customer network/KMS policies."

Marco: Pricing: Hosted = usage with trial credits; Dedicated = monthly reserved commit. Sales should collect expected DAU and sync QPS to size commit.

ops-bot: POC staging deploy scheduled 2026-04-02T01:00Z.

Aisha: Action items: Marco provide SCIM config snippet + SLA, Devina provide role-mapping example, Sales to collect expected user counts. I'll upload questionnaire draft once we have these.

Marco: SCIM patch example for QA: PATCH /scim/v2/Users with body: [ { "op": "replace", "path": "emails[0].value", "value": "u@meridian.co" } ]

Aisha: Thanks team :thumbsup:
